purpose: Hash-pinned access record for the William Lilly, Christian Astrology (1647) witnesses used by lilly_ca_rule_manifest.json

work.author: William Lilly (1602-1681)
work.title: Christian Astrology modestly Treated of in three Books
work.edition: London: printed by Tho. Brudenell for John Partridge and Humph. Blunden, 1647 (first edition)
work.rights: published 1647; public domain worldwide. The Wellcome item carries an explicit Public Domain Mark 1.0.
work.tcp_check: Not transcribed by EEBO-TCP: the textcreationpartnership/Texts catalog (TCP.csv, retrieved 2026-08-03) contains no Christian Astrology row for Wing L2215 among its Lilly entries; OCR text layers of the 1647 scans are therefore the best available machine text.

artifacts.role: primary prose witness (long-s OCR'd as 'f'; tables degraded)
artifacts.item: https://archive.org/details/b30338724 (Wellcome Collection scan, Public Domain Mark 1.0)

artifacts.role: second prose witness (preserves long-s; independent OCR of an independent 1647 copy)
page photograph of CA 1647 p. 107 (the orb/moiety table); controlling witness for every digit of both orb columns
page photograph of CA 1647 p. 115 (the fortitude/debility point table); controlling witness for all 8 essential and 33 accidental point values

consulted_not_pinned.what: archive.org 1659 second-edition scans (b30328524_0001) and later-edition items
consulted_not_pinned.why_not: the 1647 first edition is the controlling witness; the 1659 printing was not needed

consulted_not_pinned.what: b30338724_djvu.xml (26 MB word-coordinate layer) and b30338724_page_numbers.json
consulted_not_pinned.why_not: used transiently to map printed pages 107/115 to scan leaves 141/149; not needed at rest

legibility_verdict.connected_prose: good in both witnesses; all doctrine passages quoted in the manifest were read whole, in both witnesses where cited
legibility_verdict.numeric_tables: degraded in both OCR layers (planet sigils and column digits garbled); resolved by reading the two pinned page photographs digit-by-digit
legibility_verdict.evidence: BIM layer renders the p.115 table with missing digits (e.g. txt lines ~8350-8390); Wellcome layer drops the debility digits into a garbled line ('00 4^ v-A 4^ <ui 4*'). Recorded honestly; the photographs are controlling.
